notes: Caps count Unicode code points (Python str indexing); in Dart iterate runes, never String.length (UTF-16 units).

collapse(text, cap): split on the whitespace_code_points set (runs of any of them), drop empty pieces, join with one space; then, if longer than cap code points, cut to cap and trim trailing U+0020 again (after collapse no other whitespace can remain).
The cut never adds an ellipsis. A cut may split a grapheme (emoji + skin tone, e + combining accent): that is intended; cut code points, not grapheme clusters.

People: each name is collapsed and capped at PEOPLE_NAME_CAP first; empty and null names are dropped; de-dup is case-insensitive on that collapsed+capped name; first seen wins; at most PEOPLE_MAX names, joined with ', '; none -> '(none)'.
de-dup compares Python str.lower() of the collapsed+capped name: full Unicode lowercase mapping (SpecialCasing incl. Final_Sigma and İ→i̇), NOT case folding and NOT an upper-case comparison.

Subject: collapse whitespace FIRST, then strip leading (re|fw|fwd)\s*:\s* markers repeatedly, case-insensitive (regex ^(?:(?:re|fw|fwd)\s*:\s*)+), then collapse and cap at SUBJECT_CAP; empty -> '(no subject)'.
subject: collapse FIRST; after collapsing the only whitespace left is U+0020, so `\s` in the marker regex `^(?:(?:re|fw|fwd)\s*:\s*)+` (case-insensitive) is effectively a literal space.

Messages are given OLDEST FIRST; only the newest THREAD_MESSAGES are kept, each as '<who>: <text>' with who capped at WHO_CAP (empty -> '(unknown)') and text at MESSAGE_CAP, joined by MESSAGE_SEP; none -> '(none)'. A null or empty text still renders '<who>: ' with the trailing space.
Title empty -> '(untitled)', charter empty -> '(none)', after collapsing and capping at TITLE_CAP / CHARTER_CAP.
A pair is asked in BOTH orders (expected and expected_reversed) and the two p(yes) are averaged.
U+200B (zero-width space) is NOT whitespace in Python and must survive collapsing.
U+FEFF and U+180E are NOT whitespace here: do not use Dart's trim()/trimRight()/RegExp \s; split, collapse and trim only on whitespace_code_points
